QuestInfo.name: Lost!
QuestInfo.0: There's a mysterious traveler in New Leaf City-he doesn't look like he's from anywhere around here. I should ask him what's going on. It could be interesting...
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with Elpam Gorlab, and he's a traveler from Versal, the mirror-world of MapleStory. He traveled here to observe us and our celebration, but due to the appearance of Amoria, he was thrown off-course and landed in New Leaf City. I've agreed to help get him home by collecting #b30 #t4031674#s#k. He's mentioned that the only creatures that have them here are the #o9400542#s, and I'll need to hunt at least #b60#k of them. I'll have to head to Bigger Ben and track them down. I didn't know that there was a mirror-world...I wonder if I have a double there...
QuestInfo.2: I got the #b30 #t4031674#s#k and returned them to Elpam. In return, he gave me 10 #t2002015#s, something that's sure to help me. It looks like he needs more help though...

0.0: Hello, my name is Elpam Gorlab. I am in need of assistance, do you think you can spare a moment? \n\n#L0##bYes. At the very least, you can tell me why you look so different.#k#l
0.1:
Ah. Therein lay the tale of my current predicament. I am from Versal. It is best described as a parallel dimension to the Maple World, as many things are different, yet familiar. I travel here for certain occasions to observe the people that inhabit this land. However, this time when I traveled here, I noticed that I was in a strange place. In speaking with the one called Icebyrd Slimm, I discovered my calculations were off due to the appearance of the new land, Amoria. I need to get home, but I have to adjust my enchanted compass first. I will need 30 #t4031674#s to do this properly. I believe the #o9400542#s are the only creatures in this world that may have them. I have translated this to your Quest Journal from my native language. I wish you luck, and shall await your return! 

#L0##bTell me more about your world, Versal.#k
#L1##bNo way. You smell like old cheese!#k#l
0.2: It can be thought of as the mirror dimension for the Maple World. There are similarities, but many differences as well. For instance, you may have noticed my last name is a monster here. In our world, they are benevolent creatures, and it is a mark of honor to be associated with them. It seems strange to me that they are so fearsome here... Would you help me?

1.1: Er... well, cheese is a popular form of cologne in our world... please see me again should you change your mind.

yes.0: If I am to re-calibrate this compass, I'll need #b30 #t4031674#s#k, and please defeat #b60 #o9400542#s#k. I await your return.

no.0: Please see me again if you change your mind.

1.0: Yes! This will do it. I can now adjust my enchanted compass! Thank you so much!

yes.0: If you should have the time, please see me again, for I require a final task.
